sloka: स ते सुखोचितो बालो रामस्य सहजो रिपुः ।समृद्धार्थस्य नष्टार्थो जीविष्यति कथं वशे ॥२-८-३५॥
transliteration: sa te sukhocito bālo rāmasya sahajo ripuḥ ।samṛddhārthasya naṣṭārtho jīviṣyati kathaṁ vaśe ॥2-8-35॥

translations.english: Your son, that young Bharata, is accustomed to comforts. He is a born enemy of Rama. How will he, deprived of all wealth, live under the control of Rama?
